description: Get a ready-to-paste citation for an MFG Calcs dataset — including, for vintage-tracked datasets, the ?asOf= URL that returns the numbers exactly as they read on the access date, so the citation stays checkable after revisions instead of rotting. Carries a stable site identifier rather than a DOI; none has been minted for this collection yet, and the payload says so. Call with no dataset for the catalogue of citable datasets. Same engine as /api/cite.

accessed.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the data was accessed; defaults to today

dataset.description: Dataset id from the catalogue; omit to list what is citable

name: get_citation
